structured.answer: This page is a list of things the site can't calculate or explain yet: ETC, gold, corporate bonds, Israel Bonds, structured deposits, savings policies, managers' insurance, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits and more, all marked "לא מחושב". So I won't rely on it for my deposits yet. I'll ask my son or the bank.

findings.what: The heading promises 'מוצרים', but the list also has things that aren't products: 'LBMA Gold Price' (a price), 'חברת דירוג' (a company), 'הסדר חוב' (a debt arrangement), 'עמלת חליפין' (a fee), 'היוון קצבה מוכרת' (an action), 'מענק' (a bonus on a deposit). This makes me doubt the whole list.
Black background, red tags on every card and a red warning box. It frightens me and is hard to read.
The source links, the 'נקרא גם' lines and the 'כשייסגר' lines are too small and too pale to read even enlarged
The page opens with English letters (ETC, LBMA) and gold, not with deposits. It feels like it isn't for me.
Codes like MF-28, TX2-01, TXA-28 and crossed-out dates mean nothing to me
The cards are long, there are many of them, and the cards and their text run in two side-by-side columns; I lose my place
One card's heading is cut off at the top of the screen, so I couldn't tell for sure what it was about
